name: Ischemic Stroke
definition: Acute neurological dysfunction caused by focal cerebral, spinal or retinal infarction due to arterial occlusion.

redFlags.item: Any suspected acute stroke is an emergency
Reduced consciousness, severe headache, new seizure, airway compromise

investigations.principle: Immediate brain imaging and vascular assessment guide reperfusion decisions.
investigations.MRI: CT/CTA or MRI/MRA according to local acute-stroke pathway.
investigations.radiographs: Plain radiographs have no diagnostic role.

amber: Ayurvedic or supportive therapy must never delay reperfusion/emergency stroke care.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pakshaghata may be documented as a classical correlation after emergency modern diagnosis and stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Acute neurological dysfunction caused by focal cerebral, spinal or retinal infarction due to arterial occlusion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
